description: Unit tests for the Windows DHCP PAC file adapter fetcher in Chromium, including mock implementations and various test scenarios such as normal operation, timeouts, cancellations, and real fetches.

classes.name: MockDhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Mock implementation of DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher for unit testing, with methods to simulate DHCP queries, fetch delays, and fetch completion.

classes.name: FetcherClient
classes.description: Helper class to run fetch tests with the mock fetcher, managing context, callbacks, and test execution.

classes.name: DelayingDhcpQuery
classes.description: Inner class within MockDhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher to simulate delayed DHCP responses.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Overrides fetcher cancel to set fetcher pointer to null.

methods.name: ImplCreateScriptFetcher
methods.description: Creates a mock PacFileFetcher, optionally with delay.

methods.name: ImplCreateDhcpQuery
methods.description: Creates a DHCP query object with configured delay and URL.

methods.name: WaitForResult
methods.description: Waits for fetch operation to complete and checks expected error code.

methods.name: FinishTestAllowCleanup
methods.description: Finishes the test and runs idle loop.
